title: The Lion and the Three Bulls

keywords: the lion and the three bulls
full_text:
Three mighty bulls grazed together in a lush pasture, standing shoulder-to-shoulder with lowered horns whenever a predator drew near. A lion watched them for months, unable to attack their united wall of horn and muscle.

The crafty lion began whispering slanderous lies to each bull in private, telling each that his companions were plotting against him and eating the sweetest grass.

Suspicion and jealousy tore their friendship apart. The bulls separated, each grazing alone in a distant corner of the pasture.

The lion then attacked them one by one, slaying and devouring them with effortless ease, proving that unity is invincible, while division brings ruin.
moral: Discord among allies is the open door through which enemies enter to devour.
